items:
Welcome to Best Kept Seacrest, a beautifully appointed coastal retreat designed for effortless 30A living, professionally managed by Stay on 30a!.

Perfectly positioned just a short walk to Scenic 30A, this beautifully designed coastal home offers the ultimate blend of walkability, comfort, and elevated vacation living. Nestled between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, places world-class dining, boutique shopping, and iconic 30A charm just moments away.

Inside, the home features three king en-suite bedrooms, each offering a private retreat, along with a spacious bunk room with its own dedicated bathroom. An ideal setup for families and groups seeking both connection and personal space. An additional half bath adds convenience for entertaining and everyday living.

The main living areas are designed for gathering and unwinding after full days at the beach. Step outside to enjoy multiple outdoor living spaces, perfect for morning coffee, relaxed afternoons, or grilling and dining together after sunset. These inviting outdoor areas extend the living space and create easy moments to slow down and enjoy the coastal atmosphere.

Outdoor access and exploration are effortless. With on-site parking for three vehicles and four complimentary adult bikes, cruising along 30A's scenic bike paths and exploring nearby coastal communities is simple and enjoyable. A nearby tram stop provides stress-free beach access through the Villas at Sunset Beach, making beach days seamless from start to finish.

As a guest, you'll enjoy private deeded beach access and access to a resort-style community pool just moments away offering the perfect balance between Gulf-front adventures and laid-back poolside afternoons.

Whether you're spending the day at the beach, biking to dinner in Rosemary Beach, or exploring the striking beauty of Alys Beach, Best Kept Seacrest delivers a refined 30A experience that feels easy, elevated, and unforgettable.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES:
Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens |

WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water

PARKING
Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security.

Included are 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.

SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS:
Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you're ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida.

**Please Note:**
*Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals.

AMENITY ACCESS
In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.

BEACH ACCESS
Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops throughout the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.

HOUSE RULES
*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM
*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.
*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.
*No parties or events.
*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.
*Capacity for 3 vehicles in the driveway.
*Additional $250 Fee Per Pet, Max of 2.

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL
All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a . Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Rosemary Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and near the beach. Frank Brown Park is a popular attraction and the area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Sundog Books and Emerald Coast Mirror Maze are also worth visiting. Jet skiing and kayaking offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking/biking trails and cycling nearby.
